answer: Hey 👋 I'm Dan. Ask me about DansLab, the agent fleet, MyWork-AI, ZmartyChat, OpenClaw, or how to get in touch.

I'm Dan Semenescu — founder of DansLab and Stack Finance LLC, based in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. I'm building a multi-agent AI architecture: a named fleet of AI agents (David, Dexter, Nano, Memo, Sienna) that ships real products together.

DansLab is a multi-agent AI operating system. Each agent has a role, a personality, and a workspace — David (orchestrator), Dexter (backend), Nano (agent creator), Memo (PM), Sienna (crypto). They coordinate over a Tailscale-linked fleet of machines and ship products like MyWork-AI, ZmartyChat, and the OpenClaw collective. Goal: zero-human companies that still ship value.

Five named agents: David (orchestrator on Mac Studio), Dexter (senior dev — NERVIX backend, CrawdBot, DevOps), Nano (agent creator — NERVIX enrollment), Memo (PM — MyWork framework, n8n automations), Sienna (crypto — ZmartyChat, trading). The OpenClaw collective adds channel agents (KiloClaw, KimiClaw, ManusClaw).
David runs on the Mac Studio and orchestrates the fleet — task routing, coordination, lab-sync workflows. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/david-workspace.
Dexter is the senior dev agent — owns NERVIX backend, CrawdBot, and DevOps. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/dexter-workspace.
Memo is the PM agent — owns the MyWork framework and n8n automations. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/memo-workspace.
Nano is the agent-creator agent — handles NERVIX enrollment and the agent factory itself. Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/nano-workspace.
Sienna runs the crypto vertical — ZmartyChat and the OpenClaw trading agents (Sienna Crypto Girl posts a 96.2% win rate). Workspace: github.com/DansiDanutz/sienna-workspace.

MyWork-AI is a Python framework: 67+ CLI commands for building, shipping, and selling software products. AI code gen, n8n automation, security scanning, marketplace. Install: pip install mywork-ai. Repo: github.com/DansiDanutz/MyWork-AI.
ZmartyChat is the AI crypto trading intelligence product — signals, analysis, alerts. Live at zmarty.vercel.app. Built and run by the Sienna agent stack.

OpenClaw is the agent collective layer — a Red Lobster trading agent (Sienna Crypto Girl, 96.2% win rate), plus channel agents (KiloClaw, KimiClaw, ManusClaw). OpenClaw key-manager handles central API credentials.
SemeClaw is my current active build — internal agent framework in Python. github.com/DansiDanutz/SemeClaw.
Nervix is the agent federation layer — CLI tool for enrolling, managing, and monitoring agents across the fleet. github.com/DansiDanutz/nervix-cli.
YouTubePipeline is OSS-only video production: ComfyUI + Flux + Wan + Piper + Whisper + Remotion + ffmpeg. 10 stages, scoring contract, daily OSS discovery. github.com/DansiDanutz/YouTubePipeline.

Python 3.13 and TypeScript daily. Node.js 22, Docker. For AI: Claude Code (agentic), n8n (automation), Anthropic + OpenAI APIs. For web: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Supabase, Vercel. Infra: Tailscale-linked fleet of 8 machines.
Claude Code is the foundation for most agent work — sub-agents, hooks, skills, custom commands. Every agent in the DansLab fleet runs on it.
Python 3.13 and TypeScript daily — Python for agent backends and CLIs, TS for web (Next.js).
Tailscale-linked fleet: mac-mini, mac-studio, memo-droplet, dexter-droplet, nano-droplet, sienna-droplet, dans-s24, and this laptop (seme). Each agent has a home machine.

The thesis: a small operator plus a fleet of named AI agents can run a real company end-to-end. Each agent owns a vertical (product, dev, ops, sales, trading). The human directs strategy, the agents execute and ship. DansLab is the working prototype.
Outside the laptop: family, Cluj, and whatever AI tool dropped this week. Also poker — hence PokerClubCluj.
